thread:
ana: spun up canary for rwd-v7-quant4-lite @4%. early perf is nice (p50 -19%, cost -30%) but two quality flags: code-rank MRR down ~1.7% abs and answer-trust (hallucination) on snippets +0.5pp. want to discuss concrete auto-gate numbers before enabling quiet auto-fallback. :thinking:
cole: paste the slice table? want volumes.
meera: small csv excerpt:
```
slice,queries,mrr,baseline_mrr,delta_abs,halluc_pp
short-query,9800,0.781,0.777,+0.4,0.01
code-rank,2200,0.643,0.660,-1.7,0.015
doc-extract,1200,0.502,0.516,-1.4,0.007
faq,3300,0.739,0.743,-0.4,0.003
```

dan: code-rank volume is decent. hallucation jump for code is notable (1.5% -> 1.65%). we should treat halluc_delta as first-class trigger.
cole: propose simple tiered rule: soft if weighted_delta >= 1.0% over 30m -> steer 25% traffic to fallback + increase sampling x3; hard if weighted_delta >= 2.5% over 45m OR halluc_delta_pp >= 0.8pp over 30m -> rollback. add per-slice weight: code-rank=2.0, doc-extract=1.3.
nana: spelling: "ana" not "nana" :) also coldstart noise for doc-extract was ~18% -> consider ignoring first 10% traffic per slice for gating window.
meera: draft gate snippet (inline):
```
{"metric":"mrr","weights":{"code-rank":2.0,"doc-extract":1.3},"soft":{"delta_abs":0.01,"window_mins":30,"action":"steer_25pct;sample_x3"},"hard":{"delta_abs":0.025,"window_mins":45,"action":"rollback"},"halluc_triggers":{"soft_pp":0.005,"hard_pp":0.008},"min_queries":500,"coldstart_ignore_pct":10}
```

dan: I want to tighten soft for code-rank specifically to 0.007 (0.7%) because small shifts there are impactful. also require min_queries per-slice per-window (not global) to avoid tiny slices firing.
cole: ok do per-slice override for code-rank: soft_delta 0.007, min_queries 1500. that keeps it conservative.
ops-bot: smoke report for rwd-v7-quant4-lite: unit-tests ✅, load-check ✅, quality-eval WARN (slices: code-rank, doc-extract)
nana: operational mapping: Hosted default = auto-steer soft, auto-rollback hard; Dedicated default = soft requires Ops-approval but still spawn shadow, hard triggers page SRE + local rollback if possible. include in playbook.
meera: I'll run an overnight focused shadow for code-rank (x6) and push the updated gate config PR tomorrow morning. if halluc delta stays >0.6pp we move hard_pp down to 0.006 for code-rank.
cole: add cooldown after soft action: 60m before another soft on same slice, and a 4h cooldown after hard action.
dan: agreed. action items: 1) meera run shadow + update PR 2) cole add per-slice min-volume and cooldowns to gate engine 3) ana update playbook mapping for Dedicated vs Hosted. tagging @dan for final signoff once shadow results in. :white_check_mark:
dan: will review tomorrow. thanks.
